cv.title: CV — Jie Chen
cv.headline: Full-Stack Developer
cv.summary: Full-Stack Developer with 5 years of experience building enterprise web applications at DXC Technology and Indra (Minsait). Led small teams to deliver features like multilingual support and to modernize front-end stacks. Works across the stack: scalable back-ends with Java and Spring Boot, dynamic reusable front-ends with Angular and TypeScript.

bullets: Led small teams to develop new features, such as multilingual support.
Upgraded the entire front-end stack to the latest technologies.
Contributed to task estimation and played a key role in selecting technologies and libraries.
Worked closely with designers and analysts to turn business requirements into robust technical solutions.
Built and maintained scalable back-end features with Java Spring Boot and dynamic, reusable front-end components with Angular.
Supported and mentored new team members, helping them integrate into the team.
Contributing to a Mapfre insurance platform built on a micro-frontend and micro-services architecture.
Developing Angular micro-frontends and Java Spring Boot services as part of a distributed team.
